report_extras.text: Commits waiting for a push: {commits}. Nothing was pushed.
Open the report at {run_dir}/report.md and answer the open items.

_parallel_limit: How many passes may run at once. null = as many as the waves allow, up to 8. Or a whole number 1 to 16. --parallel N on start wins over it.
_hosts: Model ids only as each tool lists them (reference/HOSTS.md). A <placeholder> names no model, so the helper inherits the main model. Or use "auto" to let the scout pick from the model cards.

codex.think: <model slug from the Codex models list>

_model_cards: Path to the card file recording which models each tool lists and when. null = no cards, the scout never runs. Path may be relative (from project root) or absolute.
_model_scout: Settings for the model discovery and selection system: max_age_days (refresh if older), preference (quality, quality-where-it-counts, cost), opencode_providers (which providers to include when discovering models).
